title: feat: add editable label assets
body:
## What changed
- Add nine editable SVG label designs in the Assets tab.
- Let users edit each label's text, font, colors, size, position, rotation, and width.
- Keep the Assets panel scrollable when the label editor is open.

## Why
This gives FontWoW a reusable, customizable asset foundation instead of static image-only stickers.

## Validation
- npm run lint (existing project warnings only)
- npm run build
- Tested locally: adding labels, editing text and font, changing colors, and scrolling the Assets panel.

title: Add font search and layer management (duplicate, reorder, undo/redo, snap guides)
body:
## Summary
Adds font search and several layer-editing improvements: undo/redo, duplicate, reorder, keyboard nudge, and snap guides.

## Changes
- Font search input, filtering by name
- Undo/redo with debounced history and keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl/Cmd+Z, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z)
- Duplicate layer
- Reorder layers (bring forward / send backward)
- Arrow-key nudge for the selected layer
- Snap guides on drag (canvas center and other layers)

## Notes
- No new dependencies
- Follows existing state/component structure in `App.jsx`

## Testing
- Manually verified in local dev

title: Add IndexedDB event-sourced project storage
body:
## Summary

This PR replaces the old **localStorage snapshot gallery** with an **event-sourced project store in IndexedDB**. Each design becomes a project with an append-only event log, so changes can be replayed, drafts auto-persist, and storage scales better than stuffing full JSON blobs into `localStorage`.

> **Rebased** onto latest `main` (includes merged work such as dev-options / HTML+CSS export). Conflicts in `App.jsx` resolved so IndexedDB gallery + gesture commits sit alongside the new main features.

### Why
- Gallery entries and the live draft were full state dumps in `localStorage` (size limits, no history).
- Continuous gestures (resize, drag, sliders) would have written many noisy events if we only debounced.

### What changed

**Storage model (DB `fontwow_es`)**
| Store | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `projects` | Metadata + gallery preview (`id`, `name`, `kind`, `headSeq`, `preview`, …) |
| `events` | Append-only log per project (`seq`, `type`, `payload`, `ts`) |
| `meta` | One-time migration flag |

**Event types**
- `project.created` — initial full design state
- `state.patched` — shallow merge patch (normal edits)
- `state.replaced` — full snapshot when needed
- `project.renamed` / `project.deleted`

**App behavior**
1. **Active draft** (`kind: 'draft'`) — canvas state is projected from the event log and auto-persists.
2. **Save to app gallery** — creates a new `kind: 'gallery'` project with a `project.created` event.
3. **Open from gallery** — replays that project’s events into a fresh draft.
4. **Delete** — removes the project and its events.
5. **Migration** — one-time import of legacy `fontwow_saved_v1` localStorage entries into IndexedDB projects.
6. **Gesture commits** — layer resize / drag / rotate and sliders **only write one event on pointer release**, not on every move. Discrete UI (chips, toggles, typing) still uses a short debounce.

**New files**
- `src/db/idb.js` — small IndexedDB helpers
- `src/db/projectStore.js` — create / patch / replay / list / delete / migrate
- `src/db/useProjectPersistence.js` — React hook (bootstrap, debounce, gesture begin/end)

App settings, custom fonts, and custom templates remain in `localStorage` (unchanged).

### Related
- https://github.com/FontWoW/FontWoW.github.io/pull/7 (undo/redo + version history) — still open; can integrate after this or be rebased on top of IndexedDB later.

## Test plan
- [ ] Open the app with a clean profile: a draft project is created in IndexedDB
- [ ] Edit text/font/colors; after a short pause, events appear for the active draft
- [ ] Resize an image layer: **no** new event until finger/mouse release; then **one** patch with final width
- [ ] Drag / rotate a layer and drag sliders: same release-only commit
- [ ] **Save to app gallery** → item appears in gallery
- [ ] Open a gallery item → design loads; editing continues on a new draft
- [ ] Delete a gallery item → it disappears and stays gone after reload
- [ ] With old `fontwow_saved_v1` data present, first load migrates entries into gallery once
- [ ] Refresh mid-edit → draft restores from IndexedDB
- [ ] Dev HTML/CSS export still works (from recent `main`)
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds

title: feat: add undo/redo and Add version history
body: فیچر اول: وضعیت ادیتور رو تو یه تایم‌لاین حافظه‌ای (۶۰ تا ورودی) نگه می‌داره تا هر تغییری که با update() یا updateLayer() انجام بشه، بشه برشگردوند. تغییراتی که فقط مربوط به انتخاب هستن، از تاریخچه رد می‌شن و با setSelection انجام می‌شن. میانبرهای Ctrl/Cmd+Z برای برگشت، Shift+Z یا Ctrl+Y برای جلو رفتن، و Ctrl/Cmd+S برای ذخیره اضافه شده، به علاوه دکمه‌های کوچیک برگشت و جلو تو نوار بالایی که وقتی دیگه چیزی برای برگشت یا جلو رفتن نباشه، غیرفعال می‌شن. فیچر دوم: طراحی‌های ذخیره‌شده حالا به‌جای یه عکس ساده و تخت، یه ساختار نسخه‌دار دارن ({ id, createdAt, updatedAt, versions: [...] }). اگه همون متن رو دوباره ذخیره کنی، یه نسخه جدید بهش اضافه می‌شه؛ وگرنه یه ورودی جدید ساخته می‌ش
